## Description
Briefly describe the purpose of this Pull Request and what changes were introduced.

## Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] ♻️ Refactoring / Performance improvement
- [ ] 🧪 Tests added / updated

## Related Issue(s)
Fixes #(issue number)

## Pre-Submission Verification
Please ensure all checks pass before submitting:
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passed without TypeScript errors
- [ ] `pnpm test` passed all unit tests
- [ ] `pnpm lint` passed without linter warnings/errors
- [ ] New/modified components include test coverage in `test/`
- [ ] Added a changeset (`pnpm changeset`) if this PR introduces a user-facing change

## Screenshots / CLI Output (if applicable)
If your PR changes CLI output or generated UI kits, attach screenshots or terminal logs here.
